turnAssumption.note: One authoritative simulation turn is one in-game calendar day. Production, transport ETAs and construction progress are driven by the central simulation clock.

manufacturingBaseline.policy: Additive-only. Existing resourceRules and processingRules remain authoritative and are not removed or rewritten.
manufacturingBaseline.simulationNotice: All new downstream recipes, output coefficients, capacities, construction costs, build durations, workforce and utility rates are GAME-SIMULATION PARAMETERS, not observed industrial measurements.
manufacturingBaseline.quantitySafety: A production cycle is bounded by every required input coefficient. Missing inputs block the cycle with no partial stock debit. The runtime does not infer conversions between incompatible units.
manufacturingBaseline.utilitySafety: Electricity/water/fuel requirements are metadata only until connected to an authoritative utility inventory and allocation ledger.
